description: WHAT THEY DID, NOT WHAT YOU DID. Every other verb here reports your own actions or the state of the page; this one hands over the tester's OWN work — each field with what they put in it, each click with whether it moved the page on, each navigation, in order, with timestamps. Reach for it when they say «write this up», «make a ticket out of that», «turn what I just did into a test», or when they describe a bug they found by hand and you need the steps that led to it. Guessing those steps from the page in front of you is the thing this removes: you were not there, and they will not remember the order. IT IS EMPTY UNLESS THEY ARE RECORDING, and that is the design rather than a limitation: the tape exists only while the person has recording switched on in the panel, with a mark on screen while it runs. An empty answer tells you how to ask them to start one. PASSWORDS AND CARD NUMBERS NEVER APPEAR — a redacted field is written down by NAME, with its value replaced by a reference, at the moment it is recorded. Reading, so it is free and needs no consent: nothing is touched, nothing is driven. AND IT DOES NOT GRADE THEM. You know what they were trying to do only if they told you; a judgement without that is a guess in a confident voice, which is worse than silence.

frameId.description: Which frame to ask, from qa_frames. Omit for the page itself. A payment form, an SSO step or an embedded widget usually lives in a frame of its own, and a cross-origin one can only be read from inside it.

limit.description: How many of the most recent actions to return (default 200, max 400)

tabId.description: Target tab (from qa_tabs); omit for the active tab

name: qa_steps
title: What the PERSON just did with their own hands
